experiment: NIFTY fixed-parameter forward PINN crisis comparison
single_baseline: Deterministic initial-moment-matched reduction; not a separately published or market-calibrated vector
loss: (price_MSE + IV_MSE + scaled_PDE_MSE)/0.01^2 + 0.1*mean(relu(-convexity)^2); exact terminal payoff by ansatz
primary_metric: Equal-date mean OTM option-price squared error normalized by D*F; all quote-level RMSEs also reported
seed_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of both final-checkpoint prices; retain every seed; no best-seed selection
split: Sort paired strikes in each date/actual-expiry group; reserve index modulo 3 == 1 before carry fitting; anchor pairs alone estimate F and D
uncertainty: Paired date-level circular moving-block bootstrap, block length 3, 2000 replicates, seed 91217, within each window; descriptive conditional interval
claims: Fixed-vector forward reconstruction only; no market parameter recovery, no unseen-date forecasting, no guaranteed Double Heston advantage; these windows are not asserted to be the historically most volatile
selection: No parameter, seed, epoch, window, or filter selection using market model errors
